materials: Poly Haven Hessian 380 (CC0) tinted light grey
polished nickel legs (plain metallic material, self-authored)
mustKeep: chaise extends forward from the LEFT end, no arm on the chaise side
two block arms (right end, back-left end)
slim splayed nickel legs, fabric body down to the leg tops
divots pull inward, silhouette stays clean
avoid: fine-grain fabric that reads smooth at room distance
any vertex pushed outward by a divot

referenceImages.use: design-inspiration-only, never copied into repo or GLB

preflight.standsOn: floor, 6 nickel pin legs (4 at the run corners, 2 under the chaise front), legs screw into the fabric-wrapped base box (0.15 to 0.30 m) that carries arms, back panel and cushions. One shared variable per junction (BASE_Z, FZ).
preflight.mechanisms: Tufting = padding held down by buttons: one padded dome per cushion, conical tension divot at each button, faint radial folds (tufted_slab from the sage sofa, plus a top-facing variant for the chaise). Block arm = padded slab, small radius. Legs = tapered cone splayed outward.
preflight.lightResponse: Woven hessian: diffuse, normal strength 2.4, spec 0.2, no sheen. Nickel: metallic 1, roughness 0.22, judged in the app viewer.
preflight.outline: Nothing changes the outline: divots pull inward only, dome kept to 2 cm, profile and side_low rendered in the first draft.

inspiration.borrowed: L-shape with left chaise, tufted back cushions, block arms, slim metal legs, light grey woven fabric
inspiration.changed: own proportions, own tuft layout and dimensions, own leg geometry
